lines.zh: 我的脚落下，土被压实了。
lines.en: My foot comes down and packs the soil flat.

lines.zh: 我的步子太沉，草来不及长回来。
lines.en: My steps fall too heavy for the grass to grow back.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过整条小径。
lines.en: One stride takes me across the entire path.

lines.zh: 草在我脚下折了，没再站起来。
lines.en: The grass folds under me and does not rise again.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向走，你听得到。
lines.en: I walk toward you, and you can hear it.

lines.zh: 我撞开灌木，枝条弹回去。
lines.en: I shoulder through a bush and the branches snap back.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: I leave a shallow trench wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，步子反而更大。
lines.en: I lower my body, and my strides grow longer.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我照样走这条路。
lines.en: Run if you like; I will take this road regardless.

lines.zh: 我的影子先一步盖住你。
lines.en: My shadow covers you a step before I do.

lines.zh: 我站着，呼吸声比风还大。
lines.en: I stand still, and my breathing is louder than the wind.

lines.zh: 我在听，六十四格内我都听得到。
lines.en: I am listening, and within sixty-four blocks I hear everything.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨牙，声音像石头刮石头。
lines.en: I grind my teeth, a sound like stone on stone.

lines.zh: 我的甲太厚，连痒都感觉不到。
lines.en: My armor is so thick that I cannot even feel an itch.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，耳朵没停过。
lines.en: My eyes half close, but my ears never stop.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，让脖子歇一会。
lines.en: I lower my head to rest my neck a while.

lines.zh: 这片地方归我，草都长不高。
lines.en: This land is mine, and even the grass grows short.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，眼里没有多少光。
lines.en: I blink, and there is little light in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴扫过地面，扫出一道弧。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground and draws an arc.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子转向风，闻你走了多远。
lines.en: I turn my snout to the wind and smell how far you went.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我更像一块岩石。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I look more like a boulder.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气把草吹倒了。
lines.en: My breath bends the grass over.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲上有一道旧痕，不疼了。
lines.en: There is an old scar on my armor; it no longer hurts.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口树干，只是试试牙。
lines.en: I bite a tree trunk just to test my teeth.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的影子，很宽。
lines.en: I look down at my shadow, and it is wide.

lines.zh: 我把背靠上山壁，歇一歇。
lines.en: I lean my back on the cliff and rest a while.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，正好在我的视线里。
lines.en: You stand there, right inside my line of sight.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，从很远就看见。
lines.en: I see you, and I saw you from far off.

lines.zh: 你握着武器的手在发抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The hand on your weapon trembles, and I see it.

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西，伤不了我。
lines.en: That thing in your hand cannot hurt me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，像看一块肉。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, as at a piece of meat.

lines.zh: 你退后了，这让我更想走。
lines.en: You stepped back, which only makes me walk on.

lines.zh: 你的汗味留在我脚边的草上。
lines.en: Your sweat stays on the grass beside my feet.

lines.zh: 你在计算距离，我也在算。
lines.en: You are measuring the distance, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我看着你的盾牌边缘，那里最薄。
lines.en: I watch the rim of your shield, where it is thinnest.

lines.zh: 你看起来很小，站在我面前更小。
lines.en: You look small, and smaller still up close.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，让你听见骨头响。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly so you hear the bones creak.

lines.zh: 别装作不是玩家。
lines.en: Do not pretend you are not a player.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可我没退。
lines.en: You landed a hit, but I did not retreat.

lines.zh: 这点疼，连旧伤都比不上。
lines.en: This pain does not match my old scars.

lines.zh: 十点护甲替我挡下了这一击。
lines.en: Ten points of armor absorbed that blow for me.

lines.zh: 你听见的是甲的声音，不是肉。
lines.en: What you heard was armor, not flesh.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你还在挥。
lines.en: I look down at you, and you are still swinging.

lines.zh: 疼只让我把重心压得更低。
lines.en: The pain only presses my weight lower.

lines.zh: 这一下留下了一道白印。
lines.en: That left a white mark on me.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，也很轻。
lines.en: You struck accurately, and very lightly.

lines.zh: 我不会被你推开的。
lines.en: You will not push me away.

lines.zh: 我的血很稠，流得慢。
lines.en: My blood is thick and flows slowly.

lines.zh: 你那点吃的，留着路上用吧。
lines.en: Save that little bit of food for the road.

lines.zh: 把面包收好，我要的是别的东西。
lines.en: Put the bread away; it is something else I want.

lines.zh: 想用食物骗我，我不上这个当。
lines.en: You would lure me with food, but I will not fall for it.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是肉，不是麦子。
lines.en: What I smell is meat, not wheat.

lines.zh: 你可以把东西放下，然后跑。
lines.en: You may put it down and then run.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，又抬起来。
lines.en: I glance down at it, then raise my head again.

lines.zh: 这种东西我一口能吞十个。
lines.en: I could swallow ten of those in a single bite.

lines.zh: 你举得再高，我也够得到。
lines.en: Raise it as high as you like; I can still reach.

lines.zh: 我不饿，但我不介意吃。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but I would not mind eating.

lines.zh: 别晃了，晃得我不耐烦。
lines.en: Stop waving it; the waving makes me impatient.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀一沉，你就歪到一边。
lines.en: My shoulder dips and you slide off to one side.

lines.zh: 我没有退，半步都没有。
lines.en: I do not yield, not half a step.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我的爪子没挪。
lines.en: You are three steps back, and my claws have not shifted.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲顶了你一下。
lines.en: My shoulder plate catches you once.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我转身不方便。
lines.en: Do not cling so close; I cannot turn easily.

lines.zh: 我从你身上跨过去，就这样。
lines.en: I simply step over you, like that.

lines.zh: 路这么窄，你只能贴着我过去。
lines.en: The path is narrow, so you must squeeze past me.

lines.zh: 撞我的东西，通常会碎。
lines.en: Things that hit me usually break.

lines.zh: 我脚下没动，地动了。
lines.en: My feet did not move; the ground did.

lines.zh: 你的骨头声音很好听。
lines.en: Your bones make a pleasant sound.

lines.zh: 这片地上没有第二头我。
lines.en: There is no second one of me on this land.

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴，我需要地盘。
lines.en: I need no companion; I need territory.

lines.zh: 有别的家伙靠近，我会先动手。
lines.en: If another comes near, I strike first.

lines.zh: 我的血统只到我这里为止。
lines.en: My bloodline ends with me.

lines.zh: 谁想站在我旁边，先赢了我。
lines.en: Whoever would stand beside me must beat me first.

lines.zh: 我闻到了同类的味道，很远。
lines.en: I catch the scent of my own kind, far away.

lines.zh: 我去看看，是谁敢留下脚印。
lines.en: I will go see who dared leave footprints.

lines.zh: 它退让了，这很好。
lines.en: It yielded, which is good.

lines.zh: 独自一个，走起来更省事。
lines.en: Alone, the walking is simpler.

lines.zh: 没有后代，也没有明天。
lines.en: No offspring, and no tomorrow either.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，不值得我低头。
lines.en: What lies there is not worth lowering my head.

lines.zh: 这枚小东西在我脚底下吱了一声。
lines.en: The little thing squeaks once beneath my foot.

lines.zh: 我不捡，我只拿走。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I take them.

lines.zh: 那袋东西归我了，你别伸手。
lines.en: That bag is mine now; keep your hands off.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，是块破布。
lines.en: I look down and see a scrap of cloth.

lines.zh: 我的爪子太大，捡不起来。
lines.en: My claws are too big to pick anything up.

lines.zh: 掉出来的东西，等会再说。
lines.en: Whatever fell out can wait until later.

lines.zh: 我用脚把它踢到一边。
lines.en: I kick it to one side.

lines.zh: 这个我拿不动，也不需要。
lines.en: I cannot carry this, and I do not need it.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下，是求我放过你吗。
lines.en: You drop your goods; are you begging me to spare you?

lines.zh: 六十四格，你已经在里面了。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks, and you are already inside that range.

lines.zh: 我转向你，把整个身子正对着。
lines.en: I turn until my whole body faces you squarely.

lines.zh: 你还站着，这算是一种勇气。
lines.en: You are still standing, which is a kind of courage.

lines.zh: 我认准了你，别换位置。
lines.en: I have chosen you, so do not change position.

lines.zh: 跑动的东西更好追。
lines.en: Running things are easier to chase.

lines.zh: 我的目标很简单，就是你。
lines.en: My aim is simple: it is you.

lines.zh: 你进视野那一刻，就定了。
lines.en: The moment you entered my sight, it was decided.

lines.zh: 远处有人在动，我转过去。
lines.en: Someone moves in the distance, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我不挑，谁近就先谁。
lines.en: I am not choosy; whoever is nearest goes first.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，这是开始的意思。
lines.en: I lower my head, which means it has begun.

lines.zh: 你还有时间走，现在还有。
lines.en: You still have time to leave; for now you do.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，像钉子钉进去。
lines.en: I have fixed on you like a driven nail.

lines.zh: 你一躲，我就换个角度。
lines.en: You dodge, and I simply take another angle.

lines.zh: 目标只有一具，别叫人来。
lines.en: There is only one target here; do not call for help.

lines.zh: 风里有汗味，从你那边来。
lines.en: There is sweat on the wind, coming from you.

lines.zh: 你踩响一块碎石，就这样。
lines.en: You snapped a loose stone, and that was enough.

lines.zh: 我把脖子转过来，骨头响了。
lines.en: I turn my neck over and the bones creak.

lines.zh: 我慢慢起身，不打算放过你。
lines.en: I rise slowly; I am not letting you go.

lines.zh: 我眼睛不动，只有喉咙在响。
lines.en: My eyes do not move; only my throat rumbles.

lines.zh: 你向左，我的左爪就抬起来。
lines.en: You go left, and my left claw lifts.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让你看清里面的牙。
lines.en: I open my mouth so you can count my teeth.

lines.zh: 你的剑举得越久，我越不急。
lines.en: The longer you hold your sword up, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 石头挡了你，挡不住我的步子。
lines.en: The stone hides you, but it will not stop my stride.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在抖，我的很平。
lines.en: Your breath shakes; mine stays perfectly even.

lines.zh: 我把重心放低，准备冲。
lines.en: I drop my weight low and prepare to charge.

lines.zh: 还剩四步，我不打算数完。
lines.en: Four steps remain, and I do not plan to finish counting.

lines.zh: 盾牌举得再高，也护不住你的腿。
lines.en: Raise the shield higher; it still will not cover your legs.

lines.zh: 我不急，你比我更急。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you are more hurried than me.

lines.zh: 水面反光，我看得见你的影子。
lines.en: The water reflects, and I can see your shadow.

lines.zh: 我偏了一下头，让你以为有空隙。
lines.en: I tilt my head to make you think there is a gap.

lines.zh: 你喘得很重，我听得清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is heavy, and I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 再走一步，就没有退路了。
lines.en: One more step and there is no way back.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看清侧腹。
lines.en: I turn side-on so you can see my flank.

lines.zh: 你一抬脚，我的前爪先动。
lines.en: Your foot lifts and my foreclaw moves first.

lines.zh: 我几乎不会被击退，站稳了。
lines.en: I am hardly knocked back; brace yourself.

lines.zh: 你退到岩边，那里没有路。
lines.en: You back to the rock, and there is no path there.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过来，挡住后路。
lines.en: My tail sweeps around and blocks the way back.

lines.zh: 你晃了一下，我等这一下。
lines.en: You stumble once, and that is what I waited for.

lines.zh: 我这一下，够你记很久。
lines.en: This one blow you will remember a long time.

lines.zh: 爪子落下，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: My claws land and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 你被拍飞了，我都没用力。
lines.en: You are swatted away, and I barely tried.

lines.zh: 十五点的疼，慢慢体会。
lines.en: Fifteen points of pain; take your time with it.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞过去，比爪子更沉。
lines.en: My shoulder hits harder than my claws do.

lines.zh: 你的甲裂了，声音很小。
lines.en: Your armor cracks, and the sound is very small.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，把你往地上按。
lines.en: I bite down and press you into the ground.

lines.zh: 爪子擦过你的甲，留了四道沟。
lines.en: My claws graze your armor and leave four grooves.

lines.zh: 你退了七格，我走了一步。
lines.en: You fell back seven blocks; I took one step.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的头大。
lines.en: My fist is bigger than your head.

lines.zh: 你还会站起来吗，我等着。
lines.en: Will you get up again? I will wait.

lines.zh: 别躲，躲不掉的。
lines.en: Do not dodge; there is nowhere to dodge to.

lines.zh: 你落地时闷响了一声，很轻。
lines.en: You land with a muffled thud, very light.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我才刚开始。
lines.en: After that hit, I have only just begun.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，抖落碎石。
lines.en: I rise from the earth and shake off the rubble.

lines.zh: 这里的空气太轻，我不习惯。
lines.en: The air here is too thin, and I am unused to it.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先数周围有多少活物。
lines.en: I open my eyes and count the living things around me.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲还是冷的。
lines.en: My armor is still cold.

lines.zh: 这片地没有人，很好。
lines.en: No one is on this land, which is good.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，地面陷下去一点。
lines.en: I take my first step and the ground sinks a little.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是谁，也记得该做什么。
lines.en: I remember who I am, and what I am for.

lines.zh: 四面的声音我都收进来了。
lines.en: I have gathered every sound from all four directions.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一眼天，天太低。
lines.en: I glance at the sky, and the sky is too low.

lines.zh: 我得先找点东西试试牙。
lines.en: First I must find something to test my teeth on.

lines.zh: 这里将会是我的地盘。
lines.en: This will be my territory.

lines.zh: 我的关节响了一串。
lines.en: A whole string of my joints cracks.

lines.zh: 有脚步声在靠近，正好。
lines.en: Footsteps approach, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 开始吧，我等得够久了。
lines.en: Let us begin; I have waited long enough.

lines.zh: 我从岩层间挤出半个身子。
lines.en: I squeeze half my body out from between the rocks.

lines.zh: 这里的石头太软，一踩就碎。
lines.en: The stone here is soft and breaks under a step.

lines.zh: 我先试了试牙，还很利。
lines.en: I test my teeth; they are still sharp.

lines.zh: 有人在我脚下埋过东西。
lines.en: Someone buried something beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，先让土安静。
lines.en: I stand still and let the ground go quiet.

lines.zh: 我闻到草味，不合我的口味。
lines.en: I smell grass, and it is not to my taste.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，像一层薄布。
lines.en: Fire burns on my armor like a thin cloth.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，地面替我受了。
lines.en: I fall from height and the ground takes the blow.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我拖着身子往岸上爬。
lines.en: Water floods in, and I drag myself toward the shore.

lines.zh: 炸得我退了半步，只有半步。
lines.en: The blast pushes me back half a step, only half.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在甲缝里，很烦。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in a seam of my armor, which annoys me.

lines.zh: 那道光钻进骨头，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That light seeps into my bones, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我饿得发抖，这不该发生。
lines.en: I am shaking with hunger, and that should not happen.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我只哼了一声。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I only grunt once.

lines.zh: 我在黑里坠落，还想找块地落脚。
lines.en: I fall through the dark still looking for ground to land on.
